note: platform control groups -- renders fixed navigation and workspace action controls
sidebar toolbox -- renders the fixed sidebar title and platform controls
sidebar section headings -- renders fixed platform vocabulary for sidebar sections
sidebar item menus -- renders fixed per-item menu controls, excluding user-created sidebar names
application footer branding -- renders the operator's fixed brand link and logo
room-header action buttons -- renders fixed channel controls while excluding the user-created channel name
room-header toolbar -- renders the fixed set of channel action controls
message-window controls -- renders fixed new-message and jump-to-message controls while excluding the message timeline
composer formatting toolbar -- renders fixed message-composition controls
